children: Arrow Electronics entered into Amendment No. 36 to its Transfer and Administration Agreement governing its North American Asset Securitization Facility. The amendment extends the facility’s maturity to September 2, 2029, increases the limit to $1.75 billion from $1.5 billion, and adds a step-up feature for leverage ratios tied to certain material acquisitions. Participating banks include Bank of America, PNC Bank, Truist Bank, Wells Fargo Bank, Mizuho Bank, and Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation. The changes are intended to bolster liquidity and provide added flexibility for growth.
